text: 9月1日，全国社会保障基金理事会发布的2025年度报告显示，2025年，全国社会保障基金投资收益额为3906.72亿元，投资收益率为13.22%。基金自成立以来的年均投资收益率为7.62%，累计投资收益额为22916.79亿元。
text_en: On September 1, the National Council for Social Security Fund released its 2025 annual report, showing that in 2025, the national social security fund investment gains reached 390.672 billion yuan, an investment return of 13.22%. The fund's average annual investment return since inception is 7.62%, with cumulative investment gains of 2,291.679 billion yuan.
